fact_text: The guest estimated that Pakistan's ETF industry was still small, with listed ETFs totalling only about two to three billion in fund size; the transcript does not state the currency.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What are ETFs, and how can you invest in them? | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-03)

fact_text: About eight ETFs were listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange, one of them a money market ETF.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What are ETFs, and how can you invest in them? | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-03)

fact_text: The only money market ETF cited on the PSX was the HBL fund, whose underlying holdings are treasury bills.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What are ETFs, and how can you invest in them? | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-03)

fact_text: Global ETF assets were about 14 trillion US dollars, of which about 10 trillion sat in US-listed ETFs.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What are ETFs, and how can you invest in them? | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-03)

fact_text: ETFs made up roughly 25 to 30 percent of managed money in the US and 10 to 15 percent in India, against under 0.1 percent in Pakistan, by the guest's estimates.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What are ETFs, and how can you invest in them? | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-03)

fact_text: India's mutual fund industry managed about 900 billion US dollars, of which about 100 billion was in ETFs.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What are ETFs, and how can you invest in them? | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-03)

fact_text: Pakistani equity mutual funds typically carry expense ratios of about 2 to 3 percent covering management fees and other costs, while ETFs, being passively run, are generally under half that.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What are ETFs, and how can you invest in them? | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-03)

fact_text: The JS Banking ETF listed at Rs10 around 2023 and rose to about Rs40, although trading volume was low.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What are ETFs, and how can you invest in them? | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-03)

fact_text: To see an ETF's holdings on the PSX data portal, search for ETF, open the fund, and click the underlying basket, which lists each stock and its proportion.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What are ETFs, and how can you invest in them? | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-03)

fact_text: A mutual fund is redeemed by the asset manager at NAV, whereas an ETF holder must find a buyer on the exchange, so thin trading can force a sale at a discount.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What are ETFs, and how can you invest in them? | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-03)

fact_text: An ETF is only a wrapper, so its risk depends on what it holds: a 3x leveraged US equity ETF moves about three times its index, while a fund of treasury bills is low risk.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What are ETFs, and how can you invest in them? | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-03)

fact_text: The guest said Pakistan's ETF market needs more product types, including Shariah-compliant, income and money market funds, plus investor education, before trading volumes rise.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What are ETFs, and how can you invest in them? | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-03)

fact_text: The guest argued that smartphone apps and digital account opening could widen retail participation, and that KYC and AML rules should be applied in a way that does not make account opening harder.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What are ETFs, and how can you invest in them? | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-03)

fact_text: Market commentators compare the current rally with the 2007 and 2016-17 peaks in price-to-earnings multiples, and the guest said technology such as apps is the main difference from those periods.
